remarks: Take advantage of this beautifully renovated 4-bedroom single-family home located just a stone's throw from all that Downtown Stamford has to offer! Enjoy the convenience of landlord-covered outdoor maintenance and water-worry-free living at its best.  The main level features:  3 spacious bedrooms  1 full, updated bathroom  An open-concept kitchen with access to a brand-new deck-perfect for relaxing or entertaining during the summer months  Fresh paint throughout for a modern and clean feel  The lower level includes:  1 additional bedroom  A half bathroom  A large flexible space ideal for a playroom, home office, or family room  Laundry facilities for your convenience  Don't miss this rare opportunity for comfortable and stylish living near the heart of Stamford! Shared driveway and part of the back patio. Excellent credit history a MUST
